notes.title: We're releasing STEPMOM: Milf Scandal 💖 !
notes.content:
It's just about time to go and find what to write about in your seemingly calm city - you might be very surprised by what people have got to hide sometimes. Dive into the immersive story and find your sharp balance between working hard to save your job position and dealing with your tangled family relationship. 
Help Adam to find the best way to solve everything, all possible to do at an arm's length with just one of them 😉

notes.title: The life of a journalist can be very unpredictable. "-How unpredictable?" We'll
notes.content:
STEPMOM: Milf Scandal is out soon and will take you on an unusual kind of story - protagonist Adam is getting mixed up in a lot 
of unexpected events since he decided to work for a small blog as a journalist. A small city is full of unspoken secrets and 
intrigues, Adam needs to work as hard as ever because he's not far from being fired, and at the moment, he lives with his 
stepmom and stepsister - the unusual relationship between them all makes things even more special. 
A few days will fly by, and the game is here - it's better to be prepared to unfold local mysteries, navigate through every personal 
challenge Adam has and come up with some really extraordinary news. 
If you're lucky enough - you could also find something special right when we release the game.🤫

We're looking forward to seeing you on your journalistic duty!
With best regards, Lust Desires 🖤
